transcript.content: Hi, I need to add travel insurance to my upcoming flight. I thought I already added it when I booked, but it's not showing up online. Can you help me with that?

If you need to have travel insurance for your trip, you would need to cancel your current reservation and make a new booking that includes the insurance. However, please note that cancellation policies and fees would apply depending on your ticket type and when you booked.

Would you like me to look up your reservation details to review your options, or is there anything else I can help you with regarding your upcoming flight?

I really need the insurance added. I'm flying with my family and everyone else already has insurance for their flight. There must be some way to do this—can't you make an exception? I don't want to cancel and rebook everything.

I understand your frustration, and I can see how important it is for your family to all have travel insurance coverage. Unfortunately, adding travel insurance after booking is not something I can process through our system, even as an exception. This is a firm policy limitation that applies to all reservations.

Since I'm unable to add the insurance to your existing booking, I'll need to transfer you to a human agent who can review your specific situation and explore any other options that might be available.
